trial_title: Severe Aortic Valve Stenosis and Concomitant Coronary Artery Disease in Patients Undergoing TAVI
brief_summary: Patients undergoing surgical aortic valve replacement (sAVR) with concomitant coronary artery disease (CAD) are known to have higher mortality rates compared to patients without CAD. This same phenomenom has not been clearly mapped in patients with CAD that goes through a transcatheter aortic valve implantation procedure.

eligibility_table.criterion: All patients that underwent a TAVI procedure at Örebro University Hospital between 2009 till 1st december 2019.
